lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the midsection, becoming slightly more condensed as they approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line terminates abruptly at the mid-shoulder level; the 11th posterior line is fragmented into three vertically aligned segments before transitioning into the haunch spot cluster.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density grouping of approximately 8-10 white spots located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots is visible across the mid-thigh, creating a semi-connected geometric line parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white chevron pattern across the bridge of the muzzle; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; prominent white band on the lower neck near the chest transition.
